read.en: SanDisk fell 3.0% on Nov 10 to $859.99, trading $826.67–914.82. It is below the 5-day ($885.1), 10-day ($1,051.3), 30-day ($1,341.7), 100-day ($1,535.3) and 200-day ($1,276.2); only the 200-day is rising. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 2, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($1,232.71), and RSI is 29.

No level changed: the $914.82 high pierced the $904–912 resistance but faded, and the close held above the $851.6–855 support (Apr 9 close and high). Resistance is $885.1 (5-day), then $904–914.8 (Nov 6, 9 and 10 highs) and $926–947. Support is $851.6–855, then $804–831 (Nov 5, 6, 9 and 10 lows) and $758.2. A close above $914.8 would target $926–947; below $851.6, $804–831.

r.en: Nov 9 high $904; Nov 6 high $912.09; Nov 10 high $914.82
